products.name: Arize AI
products.note: ML observability; LLM tracing; evaluation framework; prompt monitoring

profile_text.body:
Arize AI is a company that describes itself as an agent observability, evaluation, and improvement platform, designed to help teams continuously improve AI agents and applications. Its tools cover tracing of LLM calls, evaluation frameworks, prompt monitoring, and experimentation, and the company says the platform is built for modern AI applications including chatbots, RAG systems, copilots, and agents. Arize integrates with more than 40 models, frameworks, and AI tools, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and DSPy.

The company offers two main products. Phoenix is described as the leading open-source platform for AI observability and evaluation, built on OpenInference and OpenTelemetry standards, and can be run locally or self-hosted. Arize AX is the company's managed AI engineering platform built on the same open standards, adding managed infrastructure, advanced agent observability, online evaluations, and continual improvement workflows. The company also offers Alyx, which it describes as similar to Cursor or Claude Code but for AI engineering, running evaluations, debugging issues, and improving agents given a problem to work on.

The site's held facts classify Arize AI under AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms, with noted capabilities spanning ML observability, LLM tracing, evaluation frameworks, and prompt monitoring. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
